proposed_repair.change: Add paired six-token NLL for all five original known words through the existing stochastic public G(E(word)) path, at fixed reconstruction_weight=1.
proposed_repair.contrast_conditions: Preserve current half-base nominal rates, all public owners, same-code generation callback, N11/raw prior, architecture, initialization, seed, DV12/noise laws, full horizon and original gates.
proposed_repair.existing_loss_retained: Current joint RpGAN and original regularizers remain; add exactly this explicit auxiliary term. Recipe.reconstruction_weight=1 is currently unused by the word caller.
proposed_repair.falsifier: No persistent improvement of those original finite inverse measurements, or continued original full-gate failure, rejects the proposal as a complete repair; coverage and inverse must not be pooled across checkpoints.
proposed_repair.implementation_requirements: Use numerically stable log probabilities from the same generator logits and prove forward/gradient parity; taking log of underflowed saved softmax values or a hard-clamped probability is insufficient. Declare a separate auxiliary training-noise stream; no silent reuse/shift of original fake or evaluation streams.
proposed_repair.learning_rate_conclusion: This one failed global LR reduction changes trajectories but does not establish that LR is irrelevant.
proposed_repair.limits: No proof of exact joint-law equality, stochastic capacity, DV12 causality, or default/speed benefit. Compressed code neighborhoods, the finite discriminator, moving support and asymmetric noisy joint distributions remain competing explanations.
proposed_repair.path: Use the actual owned differentiable fast G/E and public UpdatePolicy.generate inside the generator update, never an inference snapshot. DV12 remains in the effective query; sigma=0 matches the inverse measurement. The auxiliary NLL bypasses D and supplies a direct word -> E -> public generator -> correct-token gradient.
proposed_repair.prediction: The original five paired minimum-token probabilities and all-five exact inverse criterion should improve persistently; all generation/quality/mass gates still must independently pass.
proposed_repair.source_reason: Identical old/new generator_objective has no direct inverse loss. Paired inverse remains incomplete at all 24 clocks despite occasional individual recovery.
